ios.desc:
Need a custom ringtone fast? Ringtone Maker helps you cut songs, recordings, files, and video audio into clean ringtone-ready clips in just a few taps.

Choose the best part of any audio, preview it instantly, add smooth fade in or fade out, and export when you are ready. Whether you want a favorite song clip, a personal recording, or audio extracted from a video, the app keeps the workflow simple and focused.

Key Features:
- Trim audio precisely and keep clips up to 30 seconds
- Import from music, files, recordings, or video
- Extract audio from videos
- Add fade in and fade out for smoother tones
- Preview before exporting
- Save and manage your ringtone library
- Export ringtone-ready files with a clean workflow

Ringtone Maker is built for anyone who wants a personal sound without complicated editing tools. Open a file, choose the best part, and create a custom tone that feels like yours.

Perfect for:
• Custom iPhone ringtones
• Song and MP3 cutting
• Video to ringtone conversion
• Audio trimming
• Personal alert tones and sound clips

You can search for "Ringtone Maker Guru" in the App Store.

You can also click the link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ringtone-maker-guru/id6752212116

Feedback is welcome.
